messages:
sanjay: Heads up — seeing ~2.1x per-token latency regression on Llama-3 13B when serving chat templates that include a short system prompt (~40-60 tokens). Root trace points to the kernel selector choosing the fused RMSNorm+SiLU kernel instead of the RMS-only path.

emma: Ah — any profiling output? pprof/trace would help. Is it consistent across sequence lengths?

sanjay: Quick perf snapshot attached here (from a 1k token generation with chat prefix):

```
# perf snippet
selected_kernel: fused_rms_silu
model: llama3-13b
hidden_size: 1024
head_dim: 80
prefix_len: 48
batch: 4
time/token (fused): 6.3ms
time/token (rms_only via manual override): 2.9ms
KV cache hit-rate during prefix: 0.72
```

li: Interesting — head_dim=80 is not a multiple of 32, so the fused kernel falls back to a slower code path (scalar ops per lane). We saw similar inefficiencies on older GPUs.

olivia: Two quick ideas: 1) change kernel_selector thresholds so fused_rms_silu only chosen when head_dim % 32 == 0 AND prefix_len > 128 (benefit is amortized), 2) add a runtime small-batch fastpath when prefix_cache_hit_rate > 0.6 so we prefer lower-latency kernels.

emma: +1 to fastpath by cache-hit. In practice chat templates create a hot prefix workload — if KV hits are high, throughput optimizations are useless. We should expose a per-model override too (redwood model config).

sanjay: I drafted a minimal selector tweak, pushed to branch `sel/llama3-fused-guard`. Patch:

```
selector.rules:
  - if head_dim % 32 != 0: prefer rms_only
  - if prefix_len < 128 and prefix_cache_hit_rate > 0.6: prefer rms_only
```

olivia: Can you add a gated rollout? 10% of hosts, measure 99th perc, p50, token/sec. Also log which rule fired (for telemetry).

perf-bot: CI run results: rollout @10% -> p50 token time improved 18%, p99 improved 34% on affected instances. No regressions on non-affected configs. See job 6283.

li: Nice. One more nit: chat template trimming changed recently in runtime-templates PR which reduced prefix packing; double-check that PR didn't change prefix_len semantics (we only want to rely on cache-hit metric, not literal system prompt char count).

emma: Agreed. Sanjay — if you can open a small RFC with the telemetry schema (selector.rule, reason, head_dim, prefix_cache_hit_rate) we can iterate. I'll pair with you for the rollout plan.

sanjay: Will do this morning and start the 10% rollout. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

olivia: If rollout looks good after 24h, let's flip default for llama3-13b and add a gating flag for other Llama family models.

perf-bot: Note: test harness command used for microbench: `./bench_token --model llama3-13b --seq 1024 --prefix 48 --batch 4 --selector=branch-guard`

sanjay: filing follow-ups: 1) RFC + telemetry, 2) rollout dashboard, 3) config patch to model-catalog.

emma: Thanks — concise and actionable.
